title: simprep residue mappings (revert_to_parent, model_gem_diol)
description: Explicit atom mappings that let prep change a residue by deleting and renaming atoms (never adding any): revert a non-standard residue to its parent (TASK-004 decision 3), or turn formylglycine sulfate into the gem-diol (TASK-008). Prep refuses an option for any component without an entry for it here.

option.description: The finding option this mapping carries out; one mapping per (from, option).

to_parent.description: Parent standard residue of `to` when `to` is itself non-standard (its pdbx_struct_mod_residue record); absent when `to` is standard.

rename.description: Atom renames (old name -> new name); atoms not named here keep their names.

rename_elements.description: Element changes for renamed atoms (new name -> element), e.g. SE -> S.
